title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy journey. Expectant mothers require a balanced diet to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy, helping to build a nutritious and balanced diet.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are beneficial for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and reducing the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of bones and teeth for the baby.
- Lentils: rich in iron, supporting the production of red blood cells and reducing the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of the baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, supporting the development of muscles and tissues for the baby.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting the immune system and reducing the risk of illness.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To create a balanced and nutritious diet, pregnant women can combine these international pantry staples into their daily meals. Here are some suggestions:
- Breakfast: oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: salad with leafy greens, lentils, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: scrambled eggs with leafy greens and citrus.

## Food Safety Considerations
Pregnant women should be mindful of food safety when preparing and consuming these pantry staples. Here are some considerations:
- Cook food thoroughly before consumption.
- Avoid consuming raw or undercooked food.
- Wash hands and utensils before handling food.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a vital aspect of the pregnancy journey. Expectant mothers require a balanced diet to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. International pantry staples like oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus can help build a nutritious and balanced diet.
